series_title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
synthesis_notes: Across all synthesized candidates, dialogue continuity was safeguarded by matching character stakes rather than forcing superficial line continuations. In SYNTH_MULTI_01, the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine in Episode 25 provides the direct emotional payoff when Duke Alexander rejects Catherine in Episode 44, turning his back on her to choose the chained Juliana. In SYNTH_MULTI_02, the discovery of the poison plot in Episode 23 transitions smoothly into the ring revelation in Episode 27, ensuring the mystery elements escalate naturally. In SYNTH_MULTI_03, Alexander's vow over bloodied water in Episode 14 anchors Juliana's defiant refusal to break under threat of death in Episode 38. Finally, in SYNTH_MULTI_04, physical triumph at the altar in Episode 41 meets institutional devastation in Episode 45. All audio trims align strictly with verbatim element boundaries, avoiding arbitrary timestamp guesswork.
